name: arvindrk/extract-design-system
description: A skill that extracts design primitives from a public website into a design system starter: tokens, styles, and components, ready to turn into code. It scrapes a user-supplied public website URL with Playwright locally, and requires confirming the target is public and reachable and asking before modifying existing code.
install: npx skills add arvindrk/extract-design-system (README install section; also skills.sh listing).
